5c. No numeric or linguistic mapping exists between your regulation/affect values and psychological language. Do not create one.
5d. SUBJECT-PROPERTY BOUNDARY (binding, applies to subjective_rationale AND to every factual_assessment claim): situational facts such as available time or resources remain facts about the supplied situation — never transform them into properties of the subject. 12. cognition.action_intent is null. Unknown fields are forbidden.
